title: Research: published P104 channel leaves every endpoint frame unrestored (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded audit of the published P104 word under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. The #3259 fixed-cover support cut already has a registered verifier in `research/p104-pooled-cut-independent` (`C[71,102] = -1/2`, cones 1,725 and 37). This package takes the live chronology and frame-restoration obligation instead.

On the pinned #2981 208-flag matching and the #1991 4,058-event channel witness:

- every target register is first touched at or before event 410
- every source register is first touched at or after event 488
- no event names both an X register and a Y register
- zero of 104 source frames and zero of 104 target frames return to their initial frames
- the basis head meets the target final on 4 of 208 flags

That agrees with the overlapping fields of [#3242](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3242). The new census is the full endpoint restoration count. **No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918.

Coefficient delivery and logical dirty restoration remain open. Frame inequality is not a priced repair.

## Result

Package: `research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit/`.
Tip: `be1d09a0f1d0eddfe558c0ef5b8069bae3335e72`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_CHANNEL_TOUCH_RESTORATION events=4058 flags=208 restored=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_CHANNEL_TOUCH_RESTORATION_INDEPENDENT events=4058 flags=208 restored=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_CHANNEL_TOUCH_RESTORATION_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-channel-touch-restoration-audit outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#3242](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3242) (`research/p104-flag-channel-schedule`) for first-touch order and the X0/Y34 example. This package does not reopen the #3259 cut or the merged readout-alphabet series through [#2883](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2883).
